verdict.rationale: Auth0's own docs cover brute-force protection: it can block IPs after consecutive failed login attempts, and the changelog lists a configurable unblock mode. Breached-password detection is positioned against large-scale account takeover, which addresses the credential-stuffing threat, and Adaptive MFA prompts on risky logins. The evidence is mostly overview-level, though, and bot detection is never named. Missing for 10: explicit bot detection or CAPTCHA evidence, an explicitly named credential-stuffing feature, in-depth configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can rely on built-in protection against bots, credential stuffing, and brute-force attacks on the auth flows
